messages:
Marta P.: FYI — CloudNova confirmed they can expose eu-ber1 (Berlin) marketplace SKU and reserved capacity. Targeting a soft go-live week of 2025-05-12. Need alignment on: marketplace listing + entitlements, quota approval, KMS binding (customer-managed), and SI connector smoke test. Can owners ack? :eyes:

Ken O.: Ack. What's the initial capacity commit so infra can reserve nodes?

Marta P.: CloudNova expects to reserve 8x A100-equivalent initially, with burst to 16 for promos. Asking for a conservative quota: vCPU/GPU quota ticket to CloudNova ops.

Arjun S.: Contact at CloudNova is Amy (amy@cloudnova). SLA looks standard (99.9). Marketplace SKU is staged but pricing tier needs confirmation from pricing/legal. I'll loop Amy and share the marketplace listing URL.

Leah C.: On KMS: customer-managed KMS is fine but we need the HSM cert chain + key policy template. Legal will need the Data Processing Addendum updated for EU region. Flagging compliance: record retention settings for Private deployments.

Simone T.: SI (SysIntegrate) note: our connector requires a private endpoint and peered VPC route. Please confirm VPC CIDR and whether we can provision a dedicated subnet. Example snippet we need for infra team:```terraform
resource "aws_vpc" "berlin-redwood" {
  cidr_block = "10.50.0.0/16"
  tags = { Name = "rw-berlin" }
}
```

Ken O.: Autoscale knobs: we'll start with min=2, desired=4, max=12 nodes per pool. Batching profile for eu-ber1 will default to 'low-latency' — if workloads come in heavier we switch to 'throughput' to save cost. Also need quota ticket number to move forward.

deploy-bot: marketplace-listing-ci: build passed (job #4587), PR merged to marketplace/staging. :white_check_mark:

Arjun S.: Amy confirmed pricing window — we can offer promotional burst pricing for first 30 days if legal approves. Pinging legal now.

Leah C.: Legal (Leah) — adding tasks: update DPA + region addendum, review KMS key policy. ETA for review: 3 business days if no major edits.

Marta P.: Great. Action items: 1) Arjun -> confirm final pricing and share marketplace URL (owner: Arjun) — due 2025-04-28. 2) Ken -> open quota/provision ticket with CloudNova ops (owner: Ken) — due 2025-04-29. 3) Simone -> SI connector runbook + test plan (owner: Simone) — due 2025-05-02. 4) Leah -> legal + KMS review (owner: Leah) — due 2025-04-30. 5) infra -> prepare VPC template (owner: infra) — TBD once CIDR confirmed.

Marta P.: Quick sync tomorrow 09:00 UTC to lock calendar and confirm tickets? If so, reply with :thumbsup:. We'll keep this thread as the canonical coordination channel. :rocket:
